camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyHybridCloudClusterBypassStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterResourceId hdbc_cluster_0000 --InstanceId 'waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000' --RuleStatus on --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the manual bypass switch for a hybrid cloud SDK integration cluster
description_zh: 修改混合云SDK集成集群手动Bypass开关
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-cluster-bypass-status --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --cluster-resource-id hdbc_cluster_0000 --rule-status on --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHybridCloudClusterBypassStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation and find the target hybrid cloud cluster in the ClusterInfos array of the response. Use the value of the ClusterResourceId field. If no cluster is available, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2980286.html operation to create a hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群资源ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html接口，从返回结果的 ClusterInfos 数组中找到目标混合云集群，取其ClusterResourceId 字段值。若尚无可用集群，可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2980286.html 接口新建混合云集群
parameters.name: cluster_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of the manual bypass switch. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off (default): shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
手动Bypass开启状态，取值：

on：开启。

off（默认）：关闭
parameters.name: rule_status

parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
